source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Map reconciliation against the Hot Zone source map. Nine of the eleven numbered locations already existed in reviewed fixtures; this file recovers Crisis Center and Graceland Medical using only source-supported 2045 status and services.

entities.name: Crisis Center
entities.source_summary: Ruined remains of the former neighboring Trauma Team and Crisis Medical facilities, collapsed together and later burned. The surviving wreckage attracts scavengers seeking old medical technology, radioactive material and abandoned drug caches; it is not an operating clinic in 2045.

entities.name: Graceland Medical
entities.source_summary: Community medical service centered on Father Grace's armored mobile clinic at the former Jellical Inn. Father Grace travels to Hot Zone scavver camps to provide medical treatment and medicine without charging patients; the source leaves the clinic's funding unexplained.
